summary: This diff adds a Company -> Department -> Project dashboard drill-down plus a lightweight multi-project overview screen, and then follows up with a targeted fix commit addressing two real issues from a prior review: silent revenue truncation (now surfaced as a real revenueTruncated flag computed correctly around the MAX_INVOICE_PAGES loop, verified against the test cases for under-cap, over-cap, and no-date-range scenarios) and a misleading fetch-error state in CategoryDistributionCharts.tsx that used to render the same 'no data' message for both a genuinely empty category list and a failed fetch (now split into distinct error vs empty states, covered by a real render test with @testing-library/react). The security-critical piece, src/lib/company-scope.ts's requireCompanyScope(), correctly verifies a real membership row exists for the requested companyId before it is used as the organizationId passed to callVeridian() (which selects the org's VERIDIAN API key), preventing cross-company data access via a guessed org UUID; this is exercised by both unit tests (company-scope.test.ts) and route-level tests proving org-a and org-b requests never see each other's projects. All new routes are additive under a new /api/dashboard-hierarchy/* namespace, no existing routes, schema, auth, or CI/workflow files are touched, and the diff contains no migrations, SQL, payment/billing, or .github/workflows/** changes. The one disclosed functional gap is that the category-distribution charts depend on a not-yet-deployed VERIDIAN endpoint (category-boq-amounts) in a separate repo, but this now degrades gracefully to a clear error state rather than silently misleading the user, and it only affects the new feature, not existing functionality.
